figmaCorrections.element: Text/Hint token vs rendered hint color
figmaCorrections.issue: The Text/Hint token is defined as #374151 but hint/placeholder text in the design context actually renders #6b7280 — the token value and the applied value disagree.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Reconcile the Text/Hint token: either set the token to #6b7280 or stop using it for hint text; the current mismatch makes the hint color ambiguous for developers.
